description: Vulnerability in the Oracle General Ledger product of Oracle E-Business Suite (component: ADADMIN).  Supported versions that are affected are 12.2.3-12.2.15. Difficult to exploit vulnerability allows low privileged attacker with network access via HTTP to compromise Oracle General Ledger.  Successful attacks of this vulnerability can result in takeover of Oracle General Ledger. CVSS 3.1 Base Score 7.5 (Confidentiality, Integrity and Availability impacts).  CVSS Vector: (CVSS:3.1/AV:N/AC:H/PR:L/UI:N/S:U/C:H/I:H/A:H).
